definitions.gloss: landing a catch; unloading fish from a boat
definitions.explanation: The act of bringing caught fish or seafood from a fishing boat to the harbor. Also refers to the quantity or value of fish landed.
The total amount of money earned from sales, especially in retail or market contexts.

notes:
The fishing sense (landing a catch) is the primary meaning and appears frequently in news about the fishing industry.

SENSE 1 — FISHING:
- {水揚|みずあ}げ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount of catch landed
- {水揚|みずあ}げ{高|だか}: value of the catch
- {水揚|みずあ}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to land/unload fish
- {水揚|みずあ}げ{港|こう}: landing port

SENSE 2 — SALES REVENUE:
Used for gross sales or proceeds, but {売|う}り{上|あ}げ is more common in general business. {水揚|みずあ}げ{高|だか} can refer to either fishing revenue or general sales depending on context.

FORMS:
⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) + {揚|あ}げ (raising up) — originally the act of lifting goods out of the water onto land.
